decisions.reason: The naval lighting line rests on long certification and procurement investment and a specialist customer base, so slow uptake is read as typical of long defence procurement cycles rather than failure.
The desk lamp line has its own page and supports the ergonomic workplace positioning management has championed, so modest sales are still attributed to ramp-up and the office market's weakness.
The publicly launched G2 generation of a core interior luminaire is central to the LED portfolio, so withdrawing it so soon would contradict the firm's own announcements.
As a flagship of the firm's announced direction, the microprismatic pendant carries the highest public commitment, and any weakness would be blamed on the temporarily soft construction market.

Although withdrawing the sister searchlight F and the HMI technology's mismatch with the LED strategy raise its exposure, the sunk certification costs and loyal maritime customers lead management to persist one more year.
